paragraph1: King Internationals is a diversified business group headquartered in Portugal, with operations spanning retail supermarkets, cash & carry, wholesale, agriculture, consumer brands, and international recruitment.
paragraph2: We put customers at the heart of everything we do — delivering fresh products daily, building sustainable agricultural partnerships, and connecting talent across borders.
globalParagraph1: Beyond our extensive retail and agriculture presence in Portugal, King Internationals manages a specialized cross-border recruitment pipeline. We connect high-quality talent from Romania and Southern Europe with strategic roles across EU markets, including our growing networks in the Netherlands.
globalParagraph2: Our talent solutions prioritize ethical recruitment, comprehensive onboarding support, and continuous professional integration, ensuring success for both expanding business units and international candidates.
globalFeature1: 100% compliant recruitment processes with European labor regulations.
globalFeature2: Active legal support, relocation logistics, and language integration aid.
globalFeature3: Direct linkages between European logistics hubs and verified employment sites.
